# Test Case Rule: RULE 181: If a virtual-machine load/store instruction (HLV, HLVX, or HSV) is used to execute a load or store as though V=1, then vsstatus can affect the behavior of the machine even when the V field in mstatus is 0.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
nop # Skipped because requires VS-stage translation setup
# Result: x0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 182: If the MPRV feature in mstatus is used to execute a load or store as though V=1, then vsstatus can affect the behavior of the machine even when the V field in mstatus is 0.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
nop # Skipped because requires VS-stage translation setup
# Result: x0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 183: The MPRV feature in the mstatus register can be used to execute a load or store as though the V bit is 1.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
nop # Skipped because requires VS-stage translation setup
# Result: x0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 184: When the V bit is 0, the vsatp register does not directly affect the behavior of the machine unless a virtual-machine load/store or the MPRV feature in the mstatus register is used to execute a load or store as though V is 1.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
nop # Skipped because requires VS-stage translation setup
# Result: x0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 185: mstatus.TVM does not cause HFENCE.VVMA to trap.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x100000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
li a0, 1
hfence.vvma x0, x0
li a0, 0
# Result: a0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 186: HFENCE.GVMA is valid only in HS-mode when mstatus.TVM = 0.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x100000
csrrc x0, mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
li a0, 1
hfence.gvma x0, x0
li a0, 0
# Result: a0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 187: HFENCE.GVMA is valid in M-mode irrespective of the value of mstatus.TVM.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x100000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
li a0, 1
hfence.gvma x0, x0
li a0, 0
# Result: a0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 188: Executing HFENCE.GVMA in HS-mode when mstatus.TVM = 1 causes an illegal-instruction exception.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x100000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
hfence.gvma x0, x0
# Result: mcause = 2

# Test Case Rule: RULE 189: MPV is written by the implementation whenever a trap is taken into M-mode.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x8000000000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
csrrw x0, time, x0
# Result: mstatus[39] = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 190: When a trap is taken into M-mode, MPV in mstatus is set to the value of the virtualization mode V at the time of the trap.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
nop # Skipped because requires trap into M-mode while V=1
# Result: x0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 191: When an MRET instruction is executed, the virtualization mode V is set to MPV in mstatus unless MPP = 3, in which case V remains 0.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
la t0, mret_cont
csrw mepc, t0
li t0, 0x1800
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
li t0, 0x8000000000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
mret
mret_cont: nop
# Result: mstatus[37] = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 192: GVA is written by the implementation whenever a trap is taken into M-mode.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x4000000000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
csrrw x0, time, x0
# Result: mstatus[38] = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 193: For any trap that writes a guest virtual address to mtval, GVA in mstatus is set to 1.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
nop # Skipped because requires trap that writes guest virtual address to mtval
# Result: x0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 194: For any other trap into M-mode, GVA in mstatus is set to 0.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x4000000000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
csrrw x0, time, x0
# Result: mstatus[38] = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 195: The TSR field of mstatus affects execution only in HS-mode and does not affect execution in VS-mode.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x400000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
sret
# Result: mcause = 2

# Test Case Rule: RULE 196: The TVM field of mstatus affects execution only in HS-mode and does not affect execution in VS-mode.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x100000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
csrr t0, hgatp
# Result: mcause = 2

# Test Case Rule: RULE 197: The TW field of mstatus affects execution in all modes except M-mode.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
nop # Skipped because WFI is disallowed by test format
# Result: x0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 198: Setting TVM = 1 in mstatus prevents HS-mode from accessing hgatp or executing HFENCE.GVMA or HINVAL.GVMA.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x100000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
hfence.gvma x0, x0
# Result: mcause = 2

# Test Case Rule: RULE 199: Setting TVM = 1 in mstatus has no effect on accesses to vsatp or on execution of HFENCE.VVMA or HINVAL.VVMA.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x100000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
call machine_to_supervisor
li a0, 1
csrr t0, vsatp
hfence.vvma x0, x0
li a0, 0
# Result: a0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 200: Setting TVM = 1 in mstatus does not cause traps for accesses to vsatp, for execution of HFENCE.VVMA or HINVAL.VVMA, or for any actions taken in VS-mode.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x100000
csrrs x0, mstatus, t0
li a0, 1
call machine_to_virtual
li a0, 7
# Result: a0 = 7
